problem_text:
A logistics company needs to coordinate 9 delivery trucks across 9 distribution centers.

Each truck must follow a specific route represented as pairs (Center, Handling time),
where each pair specifies the distribution center where the truck must stop and the amount of time required to handle its cargo.
The order of pairs indicates the required sequence in which the stops must be completed.

Truck routes:
* T1 follows the route: (DC1, 4) → (DC3, 4) → (DC7, 8) → (DC9, 5) → (DC2, 5) → (DC6, 10) → (DC4, 6) → (DC5, 9) → (DC8, 6)
* T2 follows the route: (DC8, 1) → (DC1, 10) → (DC2, 9) → (DC7, 2) → (DC6, 10) → (DC5, 10) → (DC9, 7) → (DC3, 8) → (DC4, 8)
* T3 follows the route: (DC7, 10) → (DC1, 5) → (DC6, 9) → (DC5, 5) → (DC9, 7) → (DC3, 10) → (DC4, 9) → (DC8, 1) → (DC2, 8)
* T4 follows the route: (DC4, 8) → (DC7, 8) → (DC3, 2) → (DC5, 10) → (DC8, 5) → (DC1, 6) → (DC2, 2) → (DC6, 7) → (DC9, 6)
* T5 follows the route: (DC1, 1) → (DC2, 1) → (DC7, 5) → (DC6, 8) → (DC3, 2) → (DC9, 9) → (DC5, 1) → (DC4, 8) → (DC8, 4)
* T6 follows the route: (DC5, 5) → (DC9, 6) → (DC7, 1) → (DC3, 10) → (DC2, 10) → (DC4, 10) → (DC6, 5) → (DC8, 2) → (DC1, 6)
* T7 follows the route: (DC2, 9) → (DC3, 8) → (DC4, 8) → (DC7, 5) → (DC8, 8) → (DC5, 2) → (DC9, 2) → (DC1, 3) → (DC6, 9)
* T8 follows the route: (DC1, 5) → (DC5, 8) → (DC3, 1) → (DC7, 9) → (DC6, 9) → (DC9, 5) → (DC2, 6) → (DC8, 5) → (DC4, 10)
* T9 follows the route: (DC6, 10) → (DC2, 5) → (DC7, 5) → (DC3, 8) → (DC1, 1) → (DC4, 8) → (DC9, 3) → (DC5, 4) → (DC8, 6)

Each cargo handling operation must run continuously once it starts and cannot be interrupted,
and each distribution center can only handle one truck at a time.
The objective is to determine the processing order of all cargo handling operations at the distribution centers
so that the total completion time for all trucks is minimized.
